# Windows timezone conversion is a fallback-aware lookup step

GetTimezoneDefinition tries ICU's Windows-to-IANA conversion before constructing VTimeZone. It uses the converted ID only when the call succeeds and returns a nonempty result; otherwise it keeps the original lookup ID. It resets the error before serialization. The service still wraps and caches the result under the requested ID, and returns null for an empty definition. The seven added test pairs check a non-null result, a VTIMEZONE prefix and one sampled UTC-offset comparison. They do not prove equality of all timezone rules or complete ICS-import compatibility.

Scope: Calendar timezone lookup.
